semiconductor_relevance: High — ZetaTech provides integrated manufacturing software solutions specifically designed for semiconductor factories, focusing on automation and data management.
summary: Shanghai ZetaTech Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive CIM2.0 solution tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, encompassing production automation and intelligent data management. The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI, Big Data, and Cloud to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making in semiconductor and new energy sectors.

regional_presence.China: ZetaTech has established multiple operation and R&D centers across major cities including Shanghai, Hefei, Chengdu, and Beijing.
